{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:43.140588Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:43.140378Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:45.133258Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:45.132713Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:45.139121Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:45.138794Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.338214Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.336566Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.342913Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.342517Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.356894Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.356369Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.361491Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.361273Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.401224Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.400702Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.983\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.982\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     883.3\n",
      "Date:                Tue, 27 Oct 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           1.19e-40\n",
      "Time:                        18:15:50   Log-Likelihood:                0.26794\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             7.464\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             15.11\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          5.1094      0.086     59.742      0.000       4.937       5.282\n",
      "x1             0.4872      0.013     36.939      0.000       0.461       0.514\n",
      "x2             0.4548      0.052      8.771      0.000       0.350       0.559\n",
      "x3            -0.0188      0.001    -16.264      0.000      -0.021      -0.017\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.840   Durbin-Watson:                   2.165\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.657   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.896\n",
      "Skew:                           0.186   Prob(JB):                        0.639\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.460   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.412802Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.412547Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.425187Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.424696Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.63854613  5.09168409  5.50888603  5.86536475  6.14527866  6.34433442\n",
      "  6.47049239  6.54265875  6.58757924  6.63544495  6.71493197  6.84849005\n",
      "  7.04865408  7.31598473  7.63897629  7.99594702  8.35860142  8.69667909\n",
      "  8.98292644  9.19757434  9.3315862   9.38814257  9.38211866  9.33764036\n",
      "  9.2841204   9.25142594  9.26497151  9.34154342  9.48654185  9.69309361\n",
      "  9.94318139 10.21060394 10.46528087 10.67819477 10.8261587  10.89562572\n",
      " 10.88491463 10.80448616 10.67522434 10.5250053  10.38411727 10.28028435\n",
      " 10.2341115  10.2556992  10.34298399 10.48207747 10.64954812 10.81627105\n",
      " 10.95221315 11.0313674 ]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.427782Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.427551Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.438932Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.437804Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[11.0258999  10.90001256 10.67154164 10.38113367 10.08229379  9.82828584\n",
      "  9.65909148  9.59162131  9.61557455  9.69596105]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.440746Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:50.440501Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.262276Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.258700Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x762bc0156a50>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.278235Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.277983Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.307187Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.306413Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.313484Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.313267Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.332970Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.330148Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           5.109423\n",
       "x1                  0.487231\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.454818\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.018835\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.337488Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.337269Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.359578Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-27T18:15:51.359051Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    11.025900\n",
       "1    10.900013\n",
       "2    10.671542\n",
       "3    10.381134\n",
       "4    10.082294\n",
       "5     9.828286\n",
       "6     9.659091\n",
       "7     9.591621\n",
       "8     9.615575\n",
       "9     9.695961\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
